The '''Mark-5 assault droid''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And pick me up a gift, all right, sweetheart? Maybe a Mark-5 assault droid?|Darmas Pollaran|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The Mark-5 assault droid is only mentioned by [[Darmas Pollaran]] if the player's [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] character is female.
